name: Cubing In Creek 2023

venue.name: Cherry Creek High School
venue.address: 9300 E Union Ave, Greenwood Village, CO 80111
venue.details: Enter through Campus Drive on South Yosemite Street and park at the West parking and follow signs for South Gym

information: You MUST read the required tabs on the website before registering for the competition. These tabs pertain to COVID-19 safety, and your responsibilities as a competitior. The competitor limit for this competition is only 80 competitors, so be sure to register quick to get a spot! Please note that each competitor is only allowed to bring two guests. There is limited space in the venue, and we want to ensure that as many people as possible have the opportunity to compete. Thank you for your compliance.
